text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Who pays for all this? A motor drives the flow; in the Earth, convection does. The flow stretches the field; the field brakes the flow. Once growth stops, every watt that goes in leaves as heat, on average. A dynamo turns motion into field; it creates no energy.
